# R6.10 — PROXY-CORE: hh-model-proxy + hh-l1-canon/1 (manifest 263)

- **Harness:** devin-desktop/swe-2-high/subagent
- **Branch:** `codex/harnessharness-r6.10` · base `origin/main` @ `73c5694c` (R6.9 tip, PR #303)
- **Merge policy:** OPERATOR — PR opened, not merged.
- **Layer:** engineered — offline-only, USD $0.00; zero production mutations; every upstream leg is a loopback fixture (REQ-XC-125).

## Landed

**PROXY-CORE (AR-08; experiments spec §4.1–§4.3):**
- `hharness-hosting::proxy` + `hh-model-proxy` binary. Downward deps only
  (gateway/budget/ledger/secrets/wire/tls); hosting tier remains removable
  (no workspace crate gains an edge into it). The runner spawns the binary
  and drives it over a newline-delimited Json control channel on stdio:
  `configure` (store_root, run_id, listen, lane, credential_env?, cap) →
  bound listen; `register_slot` → token; `revoke_slot`; `status`; `stop`.
- Single-threaded writer (`Store` is not `Send`): the owning thread runs a
  nonblocking accept loop + control drain — the ledger actor of design/33
  §1.1; serial handling keeps the declared FIFO upstream order exact.
- **Slot gate:** per-slot `mint_token` (the one shared home in
  `hh-secrets::tokens` — embed/web re-export the same impl);
  constant-time `token_matches` over live slots; `x-api-key` or Bearer;
  unknown/revoked → 401 `refused_auth`. `security.credential.bound` /
  `.revoked` rows per slot lifecycle.
- **§4.2 route table:** `POST /v1/chat/completions` + `POST /v1/messages`
  (same-dialect pass-through via `forward_raw`; R6.7 dialects),
  `GET /v1/models` verbatim (`forward_raw_method` GET leg),
  `POST /v1/messages/count_tokens` → typed Anthropic-shaped 404 —
  never a fabricated count; all else → 404 `refused_route`.
- **Field policy (declared on `hh.proxy.lane/1`):** `tool_choice` auto ⇒
  strip-with-notice, non-auto ⇒ refuse; `cache_control` recursive strip;
  `metadata` strip; `n`>1, `logprobs`, `logit_bias`, `previous_response_id`,
  `conversation`, `store` ⇒ refuse; `thinking.budget_tokens` forwarded +
  recorded not-enforced. `stream:true` ⇒ typed
  `unsupported{release_mode:buffered_heartbeat}` (R6.11 owns streaming).
- **Pins (AR-10):** `GenParamPolicy` gains `pin{path→value}` +
  `params_scope{surface→[paths]}` — additive, flat-key compatible.
  `model` pinned to the lane model and the surface's effort path
  (`reasoning_effort` / `output_config.effort`) to the slot's declared
  effort — requested + applied recorded either way.
- **Headers:** closed inbound allowlist (content-type, accept,
  anthropic-version/-beta, user-agent); auth + `*-key/-token/-secret` +
  `set-cookie` never forwarded or recorded; other names recorded,
  values dropped. Outbound D3 allowlist (content-type, retry-after,
  request-id, x-request-id, x-ratelimit-*).
- **Ledger order (§4.3):** downstream blob → `model.call.requested` →
  `control.budget.reserved` (fixture `micros` bound; any other lane →
  typed `unsupported{reservation_formula}` at step 2) →
  `attempt.started` → `attempt.completed|failed` → upstream req/resp +
  `hh.model_io/1` receipt blobs → `model.call.completed|failed` → one
  batch [`measurement.cost.attributed`, `control.budget.released`] →
  response bytes released. A phase-level `lifecycle.turn.started` scope
  nests every call (store validation requires `turn_id` for
  `model_call_id`). **No released byte without a durable terminal row**
  — the kill-point leg injects a durability fault and proves the cell
  sees nothing.
- **leak_scan (the R6.10 leg of DF-R6.7-1, REQ-XC-109):** every blob
  scanned pre-deposit against mask {Ollama key, live slot tokens} —
  key hit ⇒ deposit refused + `phase_stopped` ⇒ later admits refuse
  `refused_phase_stopped`; token hit recorded, permitted.
- **Usage/cost:** provider `usage` extracted per surface →
  `TokenDecomposition` → priced vs `ollama_glm_5_3_flash()`;
  `cache_read`/`reasoning` are `available:false` when the provider
  reports none — never `0` (REQ-XC-007).
- `hh-l1-canon/1` (`hharness-wire::l1_canon`, REQ-XC-208): C01 canonical
  reserialization · C02 admitted integral-numeric equality (never on the
  never-normalized params) · C03 header allowlist · C04 verified
  uname substitution on recorded cell facts only · C05 downstream
  `stream`/`stream_options` drop + recorded mode · C06 optional
  assistant `null` ≡ absent (provisional) · C07 Terminus session fields.
  Golden + adjacent-mutation per rule; `L1_CANON_VERSION` stamped.
- `classes.rs`: `measurement.provider.usage.observed` +
  `measurement.cost.reconciled` registered + hosted-lowering rows.
- hh-wire: `PJson` (float-preserving provider codec) + `parse_preserve`
  — upstream bodies carry verbatim lexemes (`0.7` stays `0.7`).

## Deferrals

- `DF-R6.7-1` receipt leg discharged (proxy `leak_scan` over every
  receipt/blob incl. a planted key → deposit refused + phase stop);
  cell-environment leg stays OPEN for R6.16.

## Deviations

- ~4.1k changed source/test lines vs the ≤1700 split trigger —
  recorded (the proxy core + lane doc + field-policy + ledger path +
  L1 canon land as one coherent slice; precedent R6.8 ~5.3k recorded).
- Serial upstream handling is strictly stronger than the declared
  3-way concurrency bound; the gate still records FIFO order.
- `control.budget.consumed` is not separately emitted: the fold treats
  `measurement.cost.attributed` as the spend charge (emitting both
  would double-count); `released` releases the full bound while
  `consumed` records actual — conservation holds per prefix.
